arXiv:2604.02215v1 [cs.LG] 2026 年 4 月 2 日arXiv:2604.02215v1 [cs.LG] 02 Apr 2026

适用于任意模型的通用超网络Universal Hypernetworks for Arbitrary Models

Xuanfeng Zhou
摘要Abstract

传统的超网络通常是围绕特定的基本模型参数化进行设计的，因此更改目标架构通常需要重新设计超网络并从头开始重新训练。 我们介绍Conventional hypernetworks are typically engineered around a specific base-model parameterization, so changing the target architecture often entails redesigning the hypernetwork and retraining it from scratch. We introduce the通用超网络Universal Hypernetwork(UHN)，一种固定架构生成器，可根据确定性参数、架构和任务描述符预测权重。 这种基于描述符的公式将生成器架构与目标网络参数化解耦，因此一个生成器可以跨测试架构和任务族实例化异构模型。 我们的实证主张有三个方面：(1) 一种固定的 UHN 与跨视觉、图形、文本和公式回归基准的直接训练保持竞争力； （2）同一个UHN既支持族内的多模型泛化，又支持跨异构模型的多任务学习；和 (3) UHN 能够在最终基础模型之前使用最多三个中间生成的 UHN 实现稳定的递归生成。 我们的代码位于(UHN), a fixed-architecture generator that predicts weights from deterministic parameter, architecture, and task descriptors. This descriptor-based formulation decouples the generator architecture from target-network parameterization, so one generator can instantiate heterogeneous models across the tested architecture and task families. Our empirical claims are threefold: (1) one fixed UHN remains competitive with direct training across vision, graph, text, and formula-regression benchmarks; (2) the same UHN supports both multi-model generalization within a family and multi-task learning across heterogeneous models; and (3) UHN enables stable recursive generation with up to three intermediate generated UHNs before the final base model. Our code is available athttps://github.com/Xuanfeng-Zhou/UHN.

超网络、隐式神经表示、神经网络参数化Hypernetworks, Implicit Neural Representations, Neural Network Parameterization

1 简介Introduction

超网络生成神经网络参数并广泛用于模型压缩Hypernetworks generate neural-network parameters and are widely used for model compression(Ha et al., 2016)、神经架构搜索, neural architecture search(Zhang et al., 2018)和多任务学习and multi-task learning(Navon et al., 2020)。 然而，许多现有的超网络与特定的目标架构和任务紧密耦合：适应新模型或目标通常需要重新设计和重新训练. However, many existing hypernetworks are tightly coupled to a specific target architecture and task: adapting to a new model or objective typically requires redesign and retraining(Chen and Wang, 2022; Navon et al., 2020)。 这种架构耦合可能会阻碍异构模型类的扩展，并限制在多模型和多任务设置中的使用. This architectural coupling can hinder scaling to heterogeneous model classes and limit use in multi-model and multi-task settings(Hedlin et al., 2025).

我们建议We propose通用超网络Universal Hypernetwork(UHN)，一个支持异构神经架构、任务和模式的单一固定架构生成器(UHN), a single fixed-architecture generator that supports heterogeneous neural architectures, tasks, and modalities无需改变发电机本身without changing the generator itself。 具体来说，UHN 根据对参数索引、架构信息和任务信息进行编码的确定性描述符来预测每个标量参数。. Concretely, UHN predicts each scalar parameter from deterministic descriptors that encode parameter index, architecture information, and task information.

通过将模型和任务特异性转移到调节输入（而不是特定于架构的输出头或学习的每块嵌入集）By moving model- and task-specificity into conditioning inputs (rather than architecture-specific output heads or learned per-block embedding sets(Hedlin et al., 2025; Von Oswald et al., 2019)），UHN 将超网络设计与目标架构解耦，并可扩展到异构模型系列，而不会增加生成器的复杂性。), UHN decouples hypernetwork design from target architecture and scales to heterogeneous model families without increasing generator complexity.

我们的贡献如下：Our contributions are as follows:

  • •

    单发电机跨设置的多功能性。Single-generator versatility across settings.利用一种固定的架构，UHN 可以生成异构目标模型，并且与跨视觉、图形、文本和公式回归基准的直接训练保持竞争力。With one fixed architecture, UHN generates heterogeneous target models and remains competitive with direct training across vision, graph, text, and formula-regression benchmarks.

  • •

    统一的多模型和多任务学习。Unified multi-model and multi-task learning.相同的 UHN 支持模型族泛化（包括保留的家庭成员）和多任务学习，其中任务可能使用不同的架构。The same UHN supports both model-family generalization (including held-out family members) and multi-task learning where tasks may use different architectures.

  • •

    稳定的递归超网络生成。Stable recursive hypernetwork generation.UHN 可以生成下游 UHN，并在最多三个中间生成水平上保持稳定（UHN can generate downstream UHNs and remains stable for up to three intermediate generated levels (H0→H1→H2→H3→fH_{0}\rightarrow H_{1}\rightarrow H_{2}\rightarrow H_{3}\rightarrow f, 其中, whereH0H_{0}是根 UHN，每个is the root UHN, eachHiH_{i} (i≥1i\geq 1) 是由生成的) is generated byHi−1H_{i-1}，以及最终的基础模型, and the final base modelff是由生成的is generated byH3H_{3}).

Figure 1总结了整篇论文中使用的这四种设置。 根据经验，UHN 与跨不同基准（例如 CIFAR-10）的直接训练相比具有竞争力summarizes these four settings used throughout the paper. Empirically, UHN is competitive with direct training across diverse benchmarks (e.g., CIFAR-10(Krizhevsky et al., 2009), 科拉, Cora(Sen et al., 2008)、AG新闻, and AG News(Zhang et al., 2015)）具有一个共享生成器架构。 我们进一步表明，相同的固定 UHN 可以扩展到更大、更多样化的目标网络，同时对模型族泛化、多任务学习和递归生成保持有效。) with one shared generator architecture. We further show that the same fixed UHN scales to larger and more diverse target networks while remaining effective for model family generalization, multi-task learning, and recursive generation.

2 相关工作Related Work

在本节中，我们重点关注与 UHN 核心主张最直接相关的先前工作：解耦超网络In this section, we focus on prior work most directly related to UHN’s core claim: decoupling hypernetwork(Chauhan et al., 2024)从目标架构和任务进行设计。 因此，我们强调架构耦合限制和描述符条件生成。 我们使用隐式神经表示（INR）design from target architecture and task. Accordingly, we emphasize architecture-coupling limitations and descriptor-conditioned generation. We use implicit neural representation (INR)(Essakine et al., 2024)直觉作为概念上下文，因为 UHN 将权重建模为描述符到值的函数，并且我们将额外的超网络和 INR 讨论推迟到intuition as conceptual context because UHN models weights as a descriptor-to-value function, and we defer additional hypernetwork and INR discussion toAppendix A.

2.1 超网络Hypernetworks

超网络是生成目标（“基础”）网络参数的神经网络Hypernetworks are neural networks that generate the parameters of a target (“base”) network(Ha et al., 2016; Chauhan et al., 2024)。 通过共享生成器参数化权重，超网络可以利用结构并跨参数重用，因此已应用于模型压缩. By parameterizing weights through a shared generator, hypernetworks can exploit structure and reuse across parameters, and have therefore been applied to model compression(Ha et al., 2016)、神经架构搜索, neural architecture search(Zhang et al., 2018), 多任务学习, multi-task learning(Navon et al., 2020)和集成方法, and ensemble methods(Ratzlaff and Fuxin, 2019; Deutsch et al., 2019).

尽管取得了这些成功，但许多超网络设计的灵活性和可扩展性有限：超网络输出空间与基础网络架构紧密耦合，因此增加基础模型的大小（深度/宽度）通常需要相应更大、更复杂的超网络Despite these successes, many hypernetwork designs have limited flexibility and scalability: the hypernetwork output space is tightly coupled to the base-network architecture, so increasing the size (depth/width) of the base model typically requires a correspondingly larger and more complex hypernetwork(Chen and Wang, 2022; Navon et al., 2020)。 有几项工作通过在块或组件中生成权重来减轻这种耦合. Several works mitigate this coupling by generating weights in blocks or components(Ha et al., 2016; Von Oswald et al., 2019)，或者通过使用 Transformer 将权重作为序列生成, or by producing weights as a sequence using Transformers(Vaswani et al., 2017; Chen and Wang, 2022; Ruiz et al., 2024; Hedlin et al., 2025; Gu and Yeung-Levy, 2025; Kim et al., 2026)。 然而，这些方法通常依赖于学习的嵌入来表示块/组件，并且此类嵌入的数量随着生成的块的数量而增长. However, these methods often rely on learned embeddings to represent blocks/components, and the number of such embeddings grows with the number of generated blocks(Hedlin et al., 2025; Von Oswald et al., 2019)。 因此，使超网络适应截然不同的基础架构或任务仍然需要重新设计和重新训练. Consequently, adapting the hypernetwork to substantially different base architectures or tasks frequently still requires redesign and retraining(Ha et al., 2016).

一些作品使用超网络来生成Several works use hypernetworks to generate多个multiple具有不同架构的基础网络，用于神经架构搜索或通过以目标架构的显式表示为条件进行参数初始化（例如，存储库代码或图形编码描述）base networks with varying architectures for purposes such as neural architecture search or parameter initialization by conditioning on an explicit representation of the target architecture (e.g., a memory-bank code or a graph-encoded description)(Brock et al., 2017; Zhang et al., 2018; Knyazev et al., 2021, 2023; Zhou et al., 2024; Sukthanker et al., 2024; Lv et al., 2025; Kim et al., 2026)。 一个常见的限制是，超网络通常使用适合该系列中最大架构的输出空间来实现；当生成较小的模型时，这可能会导致输出浪费或临时屏蔽/截断. A common limitation is that the hypernetwork is often implemented with an output space sized for the largest architecture in the family; when generating smaller models, this can lead to wasted outputs or ad-hoc masking/truncation(Zhou et al., 2024; Kim et al., 2026)。 此外，虽然这些方法可以捕获超网络生成的模型和完全训练的模型（支持其用于搜索或初始化）的性能之间的相关性，但生成的权重通常不如直接的端到端训练，因此需要在部署之前进行微调或重新训练. Moreover, while these approaches can capture correlations between the performance of hypernetwork-generated models and fully trained models (supporting their use for search or initialization), the generated weights typically underperform direct end-to-end training and therefore require fine-tuning or retraining before deployment(Zhang et al., 2018; Knyazev et al., 2023).

UHN 通过根据索引的确定性描述（以及适用的结构和任务描述符）预测每个标量权重来参数化基础网络，而不是根据学习的每层或每块嵌入来预测UHN parameterizes a base network by predicting each scalar weight from a deterministic description of its index (and, when applicable, structure and task descriptors), rather than from learned per-layer or per-block embeddings(Ha et al., 2016; Von Oswald et al., 2019)。 我们使用高斯傅立叶特征对这些描述符进行编码. We encode these descriptors using Gaussian Fourier features(Tancik et al., 2020)，为复杂权重场建模提供高频基础。 这种设计允许单个固定架构超网络通过仅更改调节输入来生成不同基础架构的参数。, which provide a high-frequency basis for modeling complex weight fields. This design allows a single fixed-architecture hypernetwork to generate parameters for different base architectures by changing only the conditioning inputs.

为了生成模型族，UHN 以基于 Transformer 的任务结构编码器生成的显式架构表示为条件To generate model families, UHN conditions on an explicit architecture representation produced by a Transformer-based task-structure encoder(Vaswani et al., 2017)。 与输出空间大小适合系列中最大架构的方法不同. Unlike approaches whose output space is sized to the largest architecture in the family(Zhou et al., 2024; Kim et al., 2026)，在实例化较小模型时，该公式不需要为缺失的层/组件分配参数。 另外，基于任务描述符的调节使 UHN 能够跨异构模式生成特定于任务的基础模型。, this formulation does not require allocating parameters for absent layers/components when instantiating smaller models. Conditioning additionally on task descriptors enables UHN to generate task-specific base models across heterogeneous modalities.

最后，UHN 支持递归生成，即生成另一个 UHN 的参数，然后生成基础模型权重。 递归超网络生成很少被探索，并且由于缩放和初始化不稳定而具有挑战性Finally, UHN supports recursive generation, i.e., generating the parameters of another UHN that then generates the base-model weights. Recursive hypernetwork generation has been rarely explored and is challenging due to scaling and initialization instability(Liao et al., 2023; Lutati and Wolf, 2021)。 我们的公式通过使用显式索引/结构/任务调节和显式初始化阶段来改善优化稳定性，从而实现分层（多级）模型生成，从而缓解这些问题。. Our formulation mitigates these issues by using explicit index/structure/task conditioning and an explicit initialization phase to improve optimization stability, enabling hierarchical (multi-level) model generation.

3 方法Method

3.1 通用超网络Universal Hypernetwork

3.1.1 概述Overview

给定目标规范（基本模型架构和任务），UHN 通过查询单个固定架构生成器来生成每个标量参数Given a target specification (base model architecture and task), UHN generates each scalar parameter by querying a single fixed-architecture generatorH𝜽H_{\boldsymbol{\theta}}具有确定性描述符（本质上类似于隐式神经表示）。with deterministic descriptors (similar in spirit to implicit neural representations).Figure 2说明了权重生成过程。illustrates the weight generation process.

对于基础模型For a base modelf𝐰f_{\mathbf{w}}与withNN参数，我们采用其架构的分层视图：parameters, we adopt a hierarchical view of its architecture: a模型model包括consists ofLL 层数layers，每层由若干, and each layer consists of several组件components（例如，线性层具有权重矩阵和偏差向量）。(e.g., a linear layer has a weight matrix and a bias vector).

关键思想是将所有目标特异性转移到The key idea is to move all target-specificity into the输入inputs to H𝜽H_{\boldsymbol{\theta}}。直观地说，要生成标量权重，我们需要告诉生成器 (i). Intuitively, to generate a scalar weight we need to tell the generator (i)其中which我们正在生成的参数（其在架构中的位置/类型），以及（ii）parameter we are generating (its location/type within the architecture), and (ii)什么what参数所属的模型和任务（全局和层级结构，加上任务信息）。具体来说，对于每个参数索引为model and task that parameter belongs to (global and layer-level structure, plus task information). Concretely, for each parameter indexed byii，我们形成以下确定性条件描述符（详细规范见, we form the following deterministic conditioning descriptors (detailed specifications inSection B.2）从指定的架构和任务描述：) from the specified architecture and task description:

  • •

    索引描述符Index descriptor 𝐯i\mathbf{v}_{i}，编码参数的, encoding a parameter’s结构性的structural位置和类型（例如，图层 ID、组件类型、组件内坐标）。location and type (e.g., layer ID, component type, intra-component coordinates).

  • •

    全局结构描述符Global structure descriptor 𝐬g\mathbf{s}_{g}，编码全局架构元数据（例如，模型系列、深度和其他配置级属性）。, encoding global architectural metadata (e.g., model family, depth, and other configuration-level attributes).

  • •

    局部结构描述符Local structure descriptors {𝐬ℓ,j}j=1L\{\mathbf{s}_{\ell,j}\}_{j=1}^{L}，编码层级元数据（例如层类型和输入/输出维度）, encoding layer-level metadata (e.g., layer type and input/output dimensions) forLL分别层。layers respectively.

  • •

    任务描述符Task descriptor 𝐭\mathbf{t}，编码任务级信息（例如任务类型和数据集）。, encoding task-level information (e.g., task type and dataset).

3.1.2 动机Motivation

许多现有的超网络是Many existing hypernetworks are纠缠entangled与目标模型：它们的输出接口（例如，输出维度、每层/每块嵌入的数量或专用组件头）与基础架构相关联with the target model: their output interface (e.g., output dimensionality, the number of per-layer/per-chunk embeddings, or specialized component heads) is tied to the base architecture(Hedlin et al., 2025; Von Oswald et al., 2019)。 因此，改变目标架构通常会改变超网络参数化并需要重新设计. Consequently, changing the target architecture often changes the hypernetwork parameterization and requires redesign(Chen and Wang, 2022; Navon et al., 2020)。 我们还提供基于块的超网络的扩展分析. We also provide a scaling analysis of chunk-based hypernetworks(Von Oswald et al., 2019)，显示超网络大小如何随目标模型扩展（, showing how the hypernetwork size can scale with the target model (Section B.1）。 UHN 修复了生成器参数化). UHN instead fixes the generator parameterization𝜽\boldsymbol{\theta}并将目标特异性转化为确定性条件输入，使单个 UHN 能够支持单模型、多模型、多任务和递归设置，而无需修改生成器本身。and moves target-specificity into deterministic conditioning inputs, enabling a single UHN to support single-model, multi-model, multi-task, and recursive settings without modifying the generator itself.

3.1.3 通用发电能力Universal generation capability

接下来我们将描述 UHN 如何涵盖多种生成设置。统一的主题是我们保留一个生成器We next describe how UHN covers several generation settings. The unifying theme is that we keep a single generatorH𝜽H_{\boldsymbol{\theta}}固定，并获得不同的行为fixed, and obtain different behaviors仅only通过更改我们查询它的描述符。by changing the descriptors we query it with.

递归生成。Recursive generation.

将超网络本身视为目标模型。 给定目标超网络的规范Treat a hypernetwork itself as a target model. Given the specification of a target hypernetworkHk+1H_{k+1}及其索引描述符and its index descriptors𝐯k,i\mathbf{v}_{k,i}，我们生成它的参数, we generate its parameters𝜽k+1\boldsymbol{\theta}_{k+1}使用与基本模型权重相同的过程。从根UHN开始的整体参数生成过程using the same procedure as for base-model weights. The overall parameter generation process from the root UHNH0H_{0}到基础模型to the base modelff由中间UHN生成generated by the intermediate UHNHKH_{K}可以表示为递归链can be denoted as a recursion chainH0→⋯→Hk→⋯→HK→fH_{0}\rightarrow\cdots\rightarrow H_{k}\rightarrow\cdots\rightarrow H_{K}\rightarrow f。 这种递归突出了 UHN 的核心收益：一旦为模型系列定义了描述符构造，就可以重复应用相同的机制，而无需引入特定于体系结构的头或更改输出维度。. This recursion highlights the central payoff of UHN: once the descriptor construction is defined for a model family, the same machinery can be applied repeatedly without introducing architecture-specific heads or changing output dimensionalities.

3.1.4 超高网络架构UHN architecture

本节将 UHN 前向传递描述为简单的两级管道：（i）确定性地将原始描述符编码为固定长度的特征，以及（ii）使用可学习的生成器网络将这些特征映射到标量权重。 有关推理伪代码，请参见This section describes the UHN forward pass as a simple two-stage pipeline: (i) deterministically encode the raw descriptors into fixed-length features, and (ii) map these features to a scalar weight with a learnable generator network. For inference pseudocode, seeAlgorithm 1.

第 1 阶段：编码描述符。Stage 1: encode descriptors.

给定目标规范（架构/任务），我们确定性地构造描述符Given a target specification (architecture/task), we deterministically construct descriptors(𝐯i,𝐬g,{𝐬ℓ,j}j=1L,𝐭)(\mathbf{v}_{i},\mathbf{s}_{g},\{\mathbf{s}_{\ell,j}\}_{j=1}^{L},\mathbf{t})对于每个参数索引for each parameter indexii。 在较高层面上，第 1 阶段应用高斯傅里叶特征. At a high level, Stage 1 applies Gaussian Fourier features(Tancik et al., 2020)减轻谱偏差（神经网络倾向于首先拟合低频函数），使生成器更容易表示权重场中的高频结构。具体来说，我们形成每层任务结构描述符to mitigate spectral bias (neural networks tend to fit low-frequency functions first), making it easier for the generator to represent higher-frequency structure in the weight field. Concretely, we form per-layer task-structure descriptors𝐮j=[𝐬g;𝐭;𝐬ℓ,j]\mathbf{u}_{j}=[\mathbf{s}_{g};\mathbf{t};\mathbf{s}_{\ell,j}]并计算固定（非学习）编码and compute fixed (non-learned) encodings for𝐯i\mathbf{v}_{i}和and𝐮j\mathbf{u}_{j}如下。as follows.

ϕi=γ𝐁𝐯​(𝐯^i),𝝍j=γ𝐁𝐮​(𝐮^j).\boldsymbol{\phi}_{i}\;=\;\gamma_{\mathbf{B}_{\mathbf{v}}}(\hat{\mathbf{v}}_{i}),\qquad\boldsymbol{\psi}_{j}\;=\;\gamma_{\mathbf{B}_{\mathbf{u}}}(\hat{\mathbf{u}}_{j}). (2)

对于每个描述符向量For each descriptor vector𝐱∈{𝐯i,𝐮j}\mathbf{x}\in\{\mathbf{v}_{i},\mathbf{u}_{j}\}，我们首先计算其元素归一化版本, we first compute its elementwise-normalized version𝐱^\hat{\mathbf{x}}（详细信息在(details inSection B.4）然后应用高斯傅里叶特征图) and then apply the Gaussian Fourier feature map

第 2 阶段：将编码映射到权重。Stage 2: map encodings to weights.

UHN的核心The core of UHNH𝜽H_{\boldsymbol{\theta}}包括 (i) 一个consists of (i) an索引分支index branch处理每个参数的索引特征that processes the per-parameter index featureϕi\boldsymbol{\phi}_{i}，以及 (ii) 可选的, and (ii) an optional任务结构编码器task-structure encoder聚合每层特征that aggregates the per-layer features{𝝍j}j=1L\{\boldsymbol{\psi}_{j}\}_{j=1}^{L}转化为单个全局调节向量。into a single global conditioning vector.

具体来说，索引分支是一个具有预激活残差的多层感知器（MLP）Concretely, the index branch is a multilayer perceptron (MLP) with pre-activation residual(He et al., 2016)块：它映射blocks: it mapsϕi\boldsymbol{\phi}_{i}通过输入线性层（输出宽度through an input linear layer (output widthdd）后面跟着 2 个预激活残差块，其中每个块由两个 (ReLU) followed by 2 pre-activation residual blocks, where each block consists of two (ReLU(Nair and Hinton, 2010) →\rightarrow层规范LayerNorm(Ba et al., 2016) →\rightarrow具有隐藏宽度的线性）层Linear) layers with hidden widthdd（无瓶颈）以及从块输入到其输出的快捷连接。(no bottleneck) and a shortcut connection from the block input to its output.

当对架构/任务进行调节时，我们通过任务结构编码器计算任务结构特征：单层 Transformer 编码器When conditioning on architecture/task, we compute a task-structure feature via the task-structure encoder: a single-layer Transformer encoder(Vaswani et al., 2017) (hh头；前馈维度等于编码器输入维度，即heads; feed-forward dimension equal to the encoder input dimension, i.e.,dff=dim(𝝍j)d_{\mathrm{ff}}=\dim(\boldsymbol{\psi}_{j});无辍学）应用于; no dropout) applied to{𝝍j}j=1L\{\boldsymbol{\psi}_{j}\}_{j=1}^{L}，然后是跨层/令牌维度的均值池化和 2 层 MLP（线性, followed by mean pooling across the layer/token dimension and a 2-layer MLP (Linear→\rightarrow ReLU →\rightarrow线性，具有隐藏和输出宽度Linear, with hidden and output widthdd;最后一个线性层零初始化）。 我们将此任务结构特征添加到索引分支表示（在残差块之后），并将融合表示通过 ReLU 和最终线性层来预测标量权重; last linear layer zero-initialized). We add this task-structure feature to the index-branch representation (after the residual blocks), and pass the fused representation through a ReLU and a final linear layer to predict the scalar weightwiw_{i}。 其他架构超参数在中给出. 3.2 培训流程Training procedure

我们使用涵盖单模型、多模型、多任务和递归设置的统一程序来训练 UHN（请参阅We train UHN using a unified procedure that covers the single-model, multi-model, multi-task, and recursive settings (seeAlgorithm 2）。 在高层次上，每次迭代都会对目标规范（架构和任务）进行采样，使用根 UHN 生成相应的参数，评估所得基础模型的任务损失，并通过整个可微生成路径反向传播梯度以更新根参数。 在实践中，我们可以选择从匹配简单参数统计的初始化阶段开始（参见). At a high level, each iteration samples a target specification (architecture and task), uses the root UHN to generate the corresponding parameters, evaluates the task loss of the resulting base model, and backpropagates gradients through the entire differentiable generation path to update the root parameters. In practice, we optionally begin with an initialization phase that matches simple parameter statistics (seeAlgorithm 3），然后是标准任务训练。 以下部分详细介绍了我们如何在训练期间对架构/任务进行采样，以及如何执行初始化。), followed by standard task training. The following parts detail how we sample architectures/tasks during training, and how we perform initialization.

4 实验Experiments

我们组织了多个实验来验证本文的主张。 单模型实验建立We organize multiple experiments to validate claims of this paper. Single-model experiments establish普遍性universality跨异构任务模型对和测试across heterogeneous task–model pairs and test可扩展性scalability随着目标大小在固定 UHN 下增长。 多模型实验测试as target size grows under a fixed UHN. Multi-model experiments test家庭层面的概括family-level generalization模型系列中的保留架构。 多任务实验评估to held-out architectures within a model family. Multi-task experiments evaluate a单一共享UHNsingle shared UHN跨异构数据集和模式。 最后，递归实验探究across heterogeneous datasets and modalities. Finally, recursive experiments probe多级生成multi-level generation通过链接 UHN。 我们对关键的 UHN 设计选择进行了消融，包括索引编码、超网络容量、任务结构编码器和初始化，如by chaining UHNs. We conduct ablations of key UHN design choices, including index encoding, hypernetwork capacity, the task-structure encoder, and initialization, as specified inAppendix G.

4.1 实验装置Experimental Setup

硬件和框架。Hardware and framework.

所有实验均在PyTorch中实现All experiments are implemented in PyTorch(Paszke et al., 2019)并在单个 NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU 上运行。 我们启用自动混合精度（AMP、FP16）以减少内存使用并加快训练速度。and run on a single NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU. We enable automatic mixed precision (AMP, FP16) to reduce memory usage and speed up training.

优化。Optimization.

训练UHN时，我们使用AdamWWhen training UHN, we use AdamW(Loshchilov and Hutter, 2017)具有余弦学习率计划with a cosine learning-rate schedule(Loshchilov and Hutter, 2016)用于初始化阶段和主训练阶段。在主要训练阶段，我们使用for both initialization phase and main training phase. In the main training phase, we use55线性学习率预热linear learning-rate warmup(Goyal et al., 2017)单模型和多模型实验的纪元，以及epochs for single-model and multi-model experiments, and10001000多任务/递归实验的预热步骤。 对于分类任务（图像/图形/文本），我们使用大小为的小批量warmup steps for multi-task/recursive experiments. For classification tasks (image/graph/text), we use mini-batches of size256256。 对于公式回归，我们使用全批量训练（批量大小等于训练集大小）。 我们在任何实验中都不使用权重衰减。. For formula regression, we use full-batch training (batch size equals the training-set size). We do not use weight decay in any experiment.

报告和拆分。Reporting and splits.

我们报告平均值We report mean±\pm多个随机种子的标准偏差，以及每个实验规定的确切种子计数。 数据集分割、基本模型架构和模型系列采样详细信息在standard deviation over multiple random seeds, with the exact seed counts stated per experiment. Dataset splits, base-model architectures and model-family sampling details are provided inAppendices C和andD为了重现性。for reproducibility.

4.2 单模型实验Single-Model Experiments

我们首先研究单模型设置：在每个实验中，我们固定一个任务和一个目标基础架构，并训练 UHN 来生成该目标模型的权重。 我们评估 (i) 跨异构任务模型对的通用性，以及 (ii) 在固定 UHN 下对更大目标模型的可扩展性。 由于任务和目标架构是固定的，因此在这种情况下我们省略了 UHN 的任务结构编码器。 详细的基本模型架构和其他实现细节在We first study the single-model setting: in each experiment, we fix one task and one target base architecture, and train a UHN to generate the weights of that target model. We evaluate (i) universality across heterogeneous task–model pairs, and (ii) scalability to larger target models under a fixed UHN. Because the task and target architecture are fixed, we omit UHN’s task-structure encoder in this case. Detailed base-model architectures and additional implementation details are provided inAppendix C.

4.2.1 普遍性Universality

设置。Setup.

我们考虑四种类型的任务： (i) MNIST 上的图像分类We consider four types of tasks: (i) image classification on MNIST(Lecun et al., 1998)和 CIFAR-10and CIFAR-10(Krizhevsky et al., 2009)通过多层感知器（MLP）或卷积神经网络（CNN）， (ii) Cora、CiteSeer 和 PubMed 上的图节点分类via multilayer perceptron (MLP) or convolutional neural network (CNN), (ii) graph node classification on Cora, CiteSeer, and PubMed(Sen et al., 2008)通过图卷积网络（GCN）via graph convolutional network (GCN)(Kipf and Welling, 2016)或图注意力网络（GAT）or graph attention network (GAT)(Veličković et al., 2017), (iii) AG News 上的文本分类, (iii) text classification on AG News(Zhang et al., 2015)和互联网电影数据库and IMDB(Maas et al., 2011)通过变压器via Transformer(Vaswani et al., 2017), 和 (iv) 通过 Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) 对其 15 个特殊函数基准进行公式回归（列于, and (iv) formula regression via Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) on its 15 special-functions benchmark (listed inTable 11) (Liu et al., 2024).

结果。Results.

我们将 UHN 生成的权重与跨视觉、图形、文本和公式任务的直接训练进行比较（We compare UHN-generated weights against direct training across vision, graph, text, and formula tasks (Table 1和andTable 11）。 我们使用 AdamW 训练直接训练基线（Direct），并使用余弦学习率计划). We train direct-training baselines (Direct) with AdamW and a cosine learning-rate schedule with55热身期。 对于每个设置，我们报告平均值和标准差warmup epochs. 分析。Analysis.

MNIST 实验作为概念验证并使用较小容量的 UHN。 所有其他实验共享相同的 UHN 架构和容量，唯一特定于实验的组件是由目标架构和任务指定的 UHN 输入描述符。在不同的设置中，尽管模态（视觉/图形/文本/公式）和目标模型系列存在很大差异，但性能仍然接近直接训练基线。The MNIST experiments serve as a proof-of-concept and use a smaller-capacity UHN. All other experiments share the same UHN architecture and capacity, and the only experiment-specific component is the UHN input descriptors specified by target architectures and tasks. Across different settings, performance remains close to the direct-training baseline despite substantial variation in both modality (vision/graph/text/formula) and target model family.

总体而言，这些结果表明单个 UHN 可以参数化具有竞争性测试性能的异构模型类，支持所提出的公式的普遍性主张。Overall, these results indicate that a single UHN can parameterize heterogeneous model classes with competitive test performance, supporting the universality claim of the proposed formulation.

4.2.2 可扩展性Scalability

设置。Setup.

我们测试可扩展性：固定容量的 UHN 是否可以在不改变超网络的情况下生成越来越大的目标模型的权重。 我们通过增加生成的网络深度（CNN-20）在 CIFAR-10 上实例化这项研究We test scalability: whether a fixed-capacity UHN can generate the weights of increasingly large target models without changing the hypernetwork. We instantiate this study on CIFAR-10 by increasing the generated network depth (CNN-20→\rightarrowCNN-32/44/56）。CNN-32/44/56).

结果。Results.

我们将 UHN 与（i）直接训练（Direct）进行比较，其中每个目标模型都经过端到端优化，以及（ii）两个基于嵌入的超网络基线：Ha 等人的超网络。We compare UHN against (i) Direct training (Direct), where each target model is optimized end-to-end, and (ii) two embedding-based hypernetwork baselines: the hypernetwork of Ha et al.(Ha et al., 2016)(HA) 和 Oswald 等人的分块超网络。(HA) and the chunked hypernetwork of Oswald et al.(Von Oswald et al., 2019)（分块）。 我们使用 AdamW 训练直接训练、HA 和分块基线，并使用余弦学习率计划(Chunked). We train direct-training, HA and Chunked baselines with AdamW and a cosine learning-rate schedule with55热身期。 遵循 CNN 中 HA 型超网络的常见做法，HA 仅生成卷积核，而其他参数则直接优化。 我们选择这些具有代表性的基于嵌入的超网络来突出常见的可扩展性模式：每个目标的嵌入导致超网络参数计数随着目标模型大小的增加而增加。 相比之下，UHN 不使用每目标嵌入，因此其参数计数与目标模型大小无关。warmup epochs. Following common practice for HA-style hypernetworks in CNNs, HA generates only the convolution kernels, while other parameters are directly optimized. We choose these representative embedding-based hypernetworks to highlight a common scalability pattern: per-target embeddings cause the hypernetwork parameter count to grow as the target model size increases. In contrast, UHN uses no per-target embeddings, so its parameter count is independent of the target model size.Table 2报告 CIFAR-10 测试准确度（平均值reports CIFAR-10 test accuracy (mean±\pmstd over 3 seeds）作为目标CNN变体。std over 3 seeds) for the target CNN variants.

分析Analysis

UHN 可以在不改变超网络架构的情况下扩展到更大的 CNN 变体：其参数数量保持固定，而 HA 和 Chunked 则随着目标大小而增长（通过更多嵌入）。 在准确性方面，UHN 与直接训练和分块相当，而 HA 在这种设置中表现最好，这可能是由于其参数化（从嵌入到权重的线性映射）受到更多约束。UHN scales to larger CNN variants without changing the hypernetwork architecture: its parameter count stays fixed, while HA and Chunked grow with target size (via more embeddings). In accuracy, UHN is comparable to direct training and Chunked, while HA performs best in this setting, potentially due to its more constrained parameterization (a linear mapping from embeddings to weights).

4.4 多任务实验Multi-Task Experiment

4.4.1 设置Setup

我们测试了 UHN 的核心多任务主张：单个固定容量超网络可以训练一次，然后用于跨异构数据集和模式生成多个特定于任务的基础模型。 我们考虑跨越视觉、图形、文本和科学回归的六个任务模型对：MNIST 上的 MLP、CIFAR-10 上的 CNN-44、Cora 上的 GCN、PubMed 上的 GAT、AG News 上的 Transformer-2L 以及 kv 上的 KAN-g5（KAN 基准测试中的 15 个特殊函数之一）。 由于多模型设置已经评估了单个任务中不同的基础架构，因此这里我们为每个任务修复一个基础架构，以隔离异构多任务训练的影响。 我们使用 UHN 中的任务结构编码器来编码基本模型结构和任务标识。We test the central multi-task claim of UHN: a single fixed-capacity hypernetwork can be trained once and then used to generate multiple task-specific base models across heterogeneous datasets and modalities. We consider six task–model pairs spanning vision, graphs, text, and scientific regression: MLP on MNIST, CNN-44 on CIFAR-10, GCN on Cora, GAT on PubMed, Transformer-2L on AG News, and KAN-g5 on kv, one of the 15 special functions in the KAN benchmark. Since the multi-model setting already evaluates varying base architectures within a single task, here we fix one base architecture per task to isolate the effect of heterogeneous multi-task training. We use the task-structure encoder in UHN to encode the base-model structure and the task identity.

4.5.3 分析Analysis

递归生成在深度范围内保持数值稳定Recursive generation remains numerically stable up to depthK=3K=3根据我们的培训协议。 随着递归深度的增加，性能逐渐下降，这是预期的，因为更深的链会复合近似误差：每个生成的超网络必须（i）可由其父网络表示，并且（ii）通过更长的可微分生成路径进行优化。 尽管如此，即使在under our training protocol. Performance degrades gradually as recursion depth increases, which is expected since deeper chains compound approximation error: each generated hypernetwork must (i) be representable by its parent and (ii) be optimized through a longer differentiable generation path. Nevertheless, even atK=3K=3由此产生的 MNIST 精度仍然接近直接训练基线，支持多级递归权重生成的可行性。the resulting MNIST accuracy remains close to the direct-training baseline, supporting the feasibility of multi-level recursive weight generation.

5 讨论Discussion

从建筑耦合到通用发电机。From architectural coupling to a universal generator.

我们的结果的中心含义是超网络设计可以与基本模型设计分离。 通过一个共享函数将固定参数描述符（索引、结构和任务信号）映射到权重，UHN 避免了特定于架构的输出参数化，这种参数化在目标模型发生变化时通常会强制重新设计The central implication of our results is that hypernetwork design can be decoupled from base-model design. By mapping fixed parameter descriptors (index, structure, and task signals) to weights through one shared function, UHN avoids the architecture-specific output parameterization that often forces redesign when the target model changes(Chen and Wang, 2022; Navon et al., 2020)。 这使得单个经过训练的 UHN 可跨异构模型系列和任务域使用，包括每个任务使用不同主干的设置。. This makes a single trained UHN usable across heterogeneous model families and task domains, including settings where each task uses a different backbone.

可扩展性和实际转移。Scalability and practical transfer.

因为 UHN 使用确定性描述符而不是学习的每层/每块嵌入集Because UHN uses deterministic descriptors rather than learned per-layer/per-block embedding sets(Hedlin et al., 2025; Von Oswald et al., 2019)，扩展到不同的架构不需要改变生成器架构本身。 我们的多模型和多任务结果表明，这种共享参数生成器捕获了跨模型的可重用结构，同时在不同基准上与直接训练基线保持竞争力。 递归实验进一步表明，这种公式是组合的：一个 UHN 可以生成另一个 UHN，在我们的训练协议下稳定生成最多三个中间 UHN。, scaling to diverse architectures does not require changing the generator architecture itself. Our multi-model and multi-task results indicate that this shared parameter generator captures reusable structure across models while remaining competitive with direct training baselines on diverse benchmarks. The recursive experiments further suggest that this formulation is compositional: one UHN can generate another, with stable generation up to three intermediate UHNs under our training protocol.

跨任务/模型的共享结构、初始化效果、限制和未来方向的扩展讨论在Extended discussion of shared structure across tasks/models, initialization effects, limitations, and future directions is provided inAppendix H.

6 结论Conclusion

通用超网络（UHN）表明，超网络设计可以与架构无关：单个生成器可以为跨任务的异构目标模型生成可训练的参数。 通过将权重建模为参数、架构和任务描述符的共享函数，UHN 无需在基础模型发生变化时重新设计超网络，并实现统一的多模型和多任务生成。 在不同的基准测试中，UHN 保持竞争力，同时还支持递归生成，具有最多三个中间 UHN 的稳定链。 总体而言，这些结果使 UHN 成为迈向通用、可重用超网络的实际一步。Universal Hypernetwork (UHN) shows that hypernetwork design can be made architecture-agnostic: a single generator can produce trainable parameters for heterogeneous target models across tasks. By modeling weights as a shared function of parameter, architecture, and task descriptors, UHN removes the need to redesign the hypernetwork when the base model changes and enables unified multi-model and multi-task generation. Across diverse benchmarks, UHN remains competitive while also supporting recursive generation, with stable chains of up to three intermediate UHNs. Overall, these results position UHN as a practical step toward general-purpose, reusable hypernetworks.

附录AAppendix A其他相关工作Additional Related Work

本节补充This section complementsSection 2通过总结为 UHN 提供背景的其他文献，重点是多任务超网络by summarizing additional literature that provides context for UHN, with emphasis on multi-task hypernetworks(Navon et al., 2020)和隐式神经表征and implicit neural representations(Essakine et al., 2024).

A.1 多任务超网络Multi-task hypernetworks

在多任务设置中，先前的工作使用超网络来生成特定于任务的参数，以鼓励参数共享并提高跨任务的总体性能In the multi-task setting, prior work has used hypernetworks to generate task-specific parameters in order to encourage parameter sharing and improve aggregate performance across tasks(Tay et al., 2021; Wang et al., 2025; Zhao et al., 2020; Mahabadi et al., 2021; Shamsian et al., 2021; Liu et al., 2022; Zhao et al., 2024; Mueller et al., 2024; Sun et al., 2025; Nguyen and Le, 2025)。 然而，许多方法假设跨任务共享基础网络架构，并根据任务表示（例如任务嵌入）调节超网络以调节生成的权重. However, many approaches assume a shared base-network architecture across tasks and condition the hypernetwork on a task representation (e.g., a task embedding) to modulate generated weights(Von Oswald et al., 2019; Navon et al., 2020)。 因此，它们并没有直接解决不同任务需要异构架构（例如用于视觉的 CNN 和用于语言的 Transformer）的实际环境，这些架构具有截然不同的输入、输出和归纳偏差. As a result, they do not directly address the practical setting where different tasks require heterogeneous architectures (e.g., CNNs for vision and Transformers for language), with substantially different inputs, outputs, and inductive biases(Beck et al., 2023; Hoang et al., 2023)。 这些限制激发了 UHN 针对异构多任务生成的任务和架构调节。. These limitations motivate UHN’s task-and-architecture conditioning for heterogeneous multi-task generation.

A.2 内隐神经表征（INR）Implicit Neural Representations (INRs)

隐式神经表示 (INR) 将信号建模为由神经网络参数化的连续坐标到值函数Implicit neural representations (INRs) model signals as continuous coordinate-to-value functions parameterized by neural networks(Essakine et al., 2024)。 大多数 INR 研究通过替代激活改进了这种映射. Most INR research improves this mapping through alternative activations(Sitzmann et al., 2020; Saragadam et al., 2023)以及更有效的坐标编码and more effective coordinate encodings(Tancik et al., 2020; Mildenhall et al., 2021; Müller et al., 2022).

将 INR 应用于神经网络权重生成可以被视为自然延伸。 然而，这个方向的探索较少，并且历史上在绩效方面落后于直接培训Applying INRs to neural-network weight generation can be viewed as a natural extension. However, this direction has been less explored and has historically lagged direct training in performance(Ha et al., 2016; Stanley et al., 2009)。 相关工作还研究了生成 INR 的超网络，而不是生成传统网络权重的 INR. Related work also studies hypernetworks that generate INRs, rather than INRs that generate weights of conventional networks(Klocek et al., 2019; Chen and Wang, 2022; Pilligua et al., 2025).

UHN 通过将网络参数建模为参数指数的函数，将 INR 观点应用于权重生成。 具体来说，UHN 将确定性索引描述符映射到标量权重，因此可以通过枚举不同的索引将相同的超网络应用于不同的基础架构，而无需更改生成器架构。 索引编码的选择至关重要：通过合适的编码，INR 式超网络可以与直接训练相媲美。 最后，我们采用有条件的INR公式UHN adapts the INR perspective to weight generation by modeling network parameters as a function over parameter indices. Concretely, UHN maps a deterministic index descriptor to a scalar weight, so the same hypernetwork can be applied to different base architectures by enumerating different indices without changing generator architecture. The choice of index encoding is critical: with suitable encoding, INR-style hypernetworks can be competitive with direct training. Finally, we adopt conditional INR formulations(Park et al., 2021; Martin-Brualla et al., 2021)通过对架构和任务描述符进行调节，使一个生成器能够跨异构模型结构和任务生成权重。by conditioning on architecture and task descriptors, enabling one generator to produce weights across heterogeneous model structures and tasks.

B.2 描述符规格Descriptor specifications

本节记录了我们实现中使用的描述符布局。 使用固定的实现定义的映射将分类属性确定性地映射到整数 ID。 不适用This section documents the descriptor layouts used in our implementation. Inapplicable指数index字段设置为fields are set to−1-1，虽然不适用, while inapplicable结构structure字段设置为fields are set to0。 在我们的实验中，. In our experiments, the任务task字段始终适用。详细的每层/每模型活动场约定在fields are always applicable. Detailed per-layer/per-model active-field conventions are provided inSection B.5.

B.5 基本模型和递归超网络结构Base-Model and Recursive-Hypernetwork Structures

概述。Overview.

在我们的实验中，每个生成的基础模型都实现为一堆层，其中每个层由多个操作组成（例如，线性/卷积算子以及可选的归一化、激活、dropoutIn our experiments, each generated base model is implemented as a stack of layers, where each layer composes several operations (e.g., a linear/conv operator together with optional normalization, activation, dropout(Srivastava et al., 2014)，和快捷方式, and shortcut(He et al., 2016)）。 特别是，每当我们说 UHN 在我们的实验中生成模型时，生成的参数总是实例化本节中定义的基本模型系列之一，并且该基本模型是 下面指定的层基元的组成。 正如正文中所描述的，每个标量权重都由一个). In particular, whenever we say that UHN generates a model in our experiments, the generated parameters always instantiate one of the base-model families defined in this section, and that base model is the composition of the layer primitives specified below. As described in the main text, every scalar weight is represented by an索引描述符index descriptor。 每层由一个表示. Each layer is represented by a局部结构描述符local structure descriptor，完整模型由, and the full model is represented by a全局结构描述符global structure descriptor与一个together with a任务描述符task descriptor。 我们首先定义整篇论文中使用的层类型，然后指定这些层如何组成完整的模型。. We first define the layer types used throughout the paper, and then specify how these layers are composed into full models.

B.5.2 模范家庭Model families

模型定义。Model definition.

令基本模型由以下组成Let the base model be the composition ofLL层（功能）layers (functions){fj}j=1L\{f_{j}\}_{j=1}^{L}:

f​(X)=fL∘fL−1∘⋯∘f1​(X).f(X)=f_{L}\circ f_{L-1}\circ\cdots\circ f_{1}(X). (25)

在我们的实验中，生成基本模型意味着生成出现在这些组成层中的所有可训练参数。 我们用一个表示每个基本模型In our experiments, generating a base model means generating all trainable parameters that appear in these constituent layers. We represent each base model with a全局结构描述符global structure descriptor和一个and a任务描述符task descriptor。 共享的全局结构描述符字段（对所有模型均有效）是 model_type 和 num_layers。 根据模型系列激活其他全局结构描述符字段：CNN 使用 cnn_stage_num、Transformers. The shared global structure descriptor fields (active for all models) are model_type and num_layers. Additional global structure descriptor fields are activated depending on the model family: CNNs use cnn_stage_num, Transformers(Vaswani et al., 2017)使用 num_encoders，递归超网络使用 num_struct_freqs 和 num_index_freqs。 任务描述符在所有模型之间共享，包括task_type和dataset_type。 下面我们以紧凑的数学形式总结了实验中使用的模型系列。use num_encoders, and recursive hypernetworks use num_structure_freqs and num_index_freqs. B.7 超参数选择Hyperparameter selection

在这里，我们总结了实验中使用的超参数和扫描协议。Here we summarize the hyperparameters and sweep protocol used across experiments.

When used, the task-structure encoder introduces additional hyperparameters, including the number of Fourier-feature frequenciesF𝐮F_{\mathbf{u}}用于任务结构描述符和注意力头的数量for task-structure descriptors and the number of attention heads(Vaswani et al., 2017) hh。 在所有实验中，我们修复. In all experiments, we fixσ=100\sigma=100，并且（当使用任务结构编码器时）我们设置, and (when using the task-structure encoder) we set(F𝐮,h)=(32,4)(F_{\mathbf{u}},h)=(32,4).

除非另有说明，我们使用Unless otherwise specified, we use(F𝐯,d,Nblk)=(1024,64,2)(F_{\mathbf{v}},d,N_{\mathrm{blk}})=(1024,64,2)对于单模型 MNISTfor the single-model MNIST(Lecun et al., 1998)实验和递归实验，以及experiment and for recursive experiments, and(F𝐯,d,Nblk)=(2048,128,2)(F_{\mathbf{v}},d,N_{\mathrm{blk}})=(2048,128,2)对于所有其他实验。for all other experiments.

扫描超参数。Swept hyperparameters.

对于每个实验设置，我们扫描初始化超参数For each experimental setting, we sweep the initialization hyperparameters(Sinit,ηinit)(S_{\mathrm{init}},\eta_{\mathrm{init}}), 其中, whereSinitS_{\mathrm{init}}表示初始化步骤的数量denotes the number of initialization steps andηinit\eta_{\mathrm{init}}表示初始化学习率。 对于训练阶段，我们扫描denotes the initialization learning rate. For the training phase, we sweep either(Strain,ηtrain)(S_{\mathrm{train}},\eta_{\mathrm{train}})当使用基于步骤的训练预算（多任务/递归设置）或when using step-based training budgets (multi-task/recursive settings) or(Etrain,ηtrain)(E_{\mathrm{train}},\eta_{\mathrm{train}})当使用基于纪元的训练预算（单/多模型设置）时，其中when using epoch-based training budgets (single-/multi-model settings), whereStrainS_{\mathrm{train}}表示训练步骤数，denotes the number of training steps,EtrainE_{\mathrm{train}}表示训练时期的数量，并且denotes the number of training epochs, andηtrain\eta_{\mathrm{train}}表示训练学习率。denotes the training learning rate.

扫描协议。Sweep protocol.

为了降低搜索成本，我们使用分阶段（而不是完全联合）扫描：To reduce search cost, we use a staged (rather than fully joint) sweep:

  1. 1.

    确定培训预算并进行清扫Fix the training budget and sweepηtrain\eta_{\mathrm{train}}与withSinit=0S_{\mathrm{init}}=0.

  2. 2.

    修复选定的训练超参数并进行扫描Fix the selected training hyperparameters and sweep(Sinit,ηinit)(S_{\mathrm{init}},\eta_{\mathrm{init}}).

  3. 3.

    修复选定的初始化超参数并细化训练超参数。Fix the selected initialization hyperparameters and refine the training hyperparameters.

我们将第一阶段的固定培训预算表示为We denote the fixed training budget in the first sweeping stage asE0E_{0}（时代）在单/多模型设置和(epochs) in single-/multi-model settings and asS0S_{0}（步骤）在多任务/递归设置中。(steps) in multi-task/recursive settings.

验证/选择标准。Validation/selection criterion.

在单模型设置中，对单个目标模型执行验证。 对于多模型实验，我们通过架构的平均验证性能来选择超参数In the single-model setting, validation is performed on the single target model. For multi-model experiments, we select hyperparameters by average validation performance over architectures inMvalM_{\mathrm{val}}。 对于多任务实验，我们使用跨任务的基于排名的聚合来比较配置（即 Borda 计数）. For multi-task experiments, we compare configurations using a rank-based aggregate across tasks (i.e., Borda count(Borda, 1781)）带有特定任务的护栏。 递归实验的选择标准遵循多任务协议。) with task-specific guardrails. The selection criterion for recursive experiments follows the multi-task protocol.

本节提供支持单模型实验的实施和评估细节This section provides implementation and evaluation details supporting the single-model experiments inSection 4.2，包括数据集、基本模型架构、附加结果和超参数选择。, including datasets, base model architectures, additional results and the hyperparameter selection.

C.1 数据集Datasets

MNIST。MNIST. MNIST (Lecun et al., 1998)是一个图像分类数据集，包含 10 个类别、60,000 个训练样本和 10,000 个测试样本（is an image classification dataset with 10 classes, 60,000 training samples, and 10,000 test samples (28×2828\times 28灰度）。 在超参数扫描期间，我们保留 20% 的训练集用于验证；最终结果是通过在完整训练集上进行训练获得的。 我们应用标准的每像素归一化。grayscale). During hyperparameter sweeps we reserve 20% of the training set for validation; final results are obtained by training on the full training set. We apply standard per-pixel normalization.

CIFAR-10。CIFAR-10. CIFAR-10 (Krizhevsky et al., 2009)是一个图像分类数据集，包含 10 个类别、50,000 个训练样本和 10,000 个测试样本（is an image classification dataset with 10 classes, 50,000 training samples, and 10,000 test samples (32×3232\times 32RGB）。 在扫描期间，我们保留 10% 的训练集用于验证。 对于训练，我们使用以下增强RGB). E.1 超参数选择。Hyperparameter selection.

我们的目标是选择一个适用于所有任务的单一多任务超参数配置。 为了避免解决方案平均表现良好但在单个任务上失败，我们强制执行特定于任务的验证护栏（Our goal is to select a single multi-task hyperparameter configuration that works well across all tasks. To avoid solutions that perform well on average but fail on an individual task, we enforce task-specific validation guardrails (Table 20）并丢弃任何违反的配置) and discard any configuration that violates任何any任务的护栏。 对于越高越好的指标（例如分类准确性），我们要求验证指标至少是护栏；对于越低越好的指标（例如 RMSE），我们要求它最多是护栏。task’s guardrail. For metrics where higher is better (e.g., classification accuracy), we require the validation metric to be at least the guardrail; for metrics where lower is better (e.g., RMSE), we require it to be at most the guardrail.

我们扫描（i）初始化阶段的学习率和步骤We sweep (i) the initialization-stage learning rate and steps(ηinit,Sinit)(\eta_{\mathrm{init}},S_{\mathrm{init}})(ii) 训练阶段的学习率和步数and (ii) the training-stage learning rate and steps(ηtrain,Strain)(\eta_{\mathrm{train}},S_{\mathrm{train}})，遵循中描述的扫描协议, following the sweep protocol described inSection B.7. The resulting sequence is average-pooled across the sequence dimension, followed by a linear layer with output size 64 and then a second linear layer with LeakyReLU.

G.1 索引编码Index Encoding

Since MLPs exhibit a spectral bias towards low-frequency functions(Tancik et al., 2020)，当目标参数字段在索引之间快速变化时，索引编码的选择可能至关重要。 请注意，索引编码应用于归一化索引描述符, the choice of index encoding can be critical when the target parameter field varies rapidly across indices. G.1.3 分析Analysis

总体而言，更具表现力的编码可以提高性能，但代价是 UHN 更大：原始编码的性能大幅下降，位置编码提供了很大的增益，而高斯傅立叶特征实现了最佳精度。 我们还可视化生成的基础模型的第三个卷积层的内核（Overall, more expressive encodings improve performance, at the cost of a larger UHN: Raw underperforms substantially, positional encoding provides a large gain, and Gaussian Fourier features achieve the best accuracy. We also visualize the kernels of the third convolution layer of the generated base model (Figure 4）。我们观察到原始编码产生低方差（较少多样性）的内核，而高斯傅里叶特征产生更加结构化和多样化的内核。 这与高斯傅立叶特征揭示高频基函数的直觉是一致的). We observe that Raw encoding produces low-variance (less diverse) kernels, whereas Gaussian Fourier features yields more structured and diverse kernels. This is consistent with the intuition that Gaussian Fourier features expose higher-frequency basis functions(Tancik et al., 2020)到超网络，减轻谱偏差并使其能够对索引空间上快速变化的参数场进行建模。to the hypernetwork, mitigating spectral bias and enabling it to model rapidly varying parameter fields over index space.

增加容量通常会提高性能，但代价是需要更多可训练参数。 增加傅里叶特征频率的数量Increasing capacity generally improves performance, at the cost of more trainable parameters. Increasing the number of Fourier-feature frequenciesF𝐯F_{\mathbf{v}}用于索引编码和 UHN 隐藏维度for index encoding and the UHN hidden dimensionddyields consistent improvements, supporting the view that richer high-frequency index features and higher-dimensional hidden representations are critical for accurate weight generation. 相比之下，增加 UHN 残差块的数量yields consistent improvements, supporting the view that richer high-frequency index features and higher-dimensional hidden representations are critical for accurate weight generation. By contrast, increasing the number of UHN residual blocksNblkN_{\mathrm{blk}}当从yields a noticeable improvement when going from0 to 11块，但仅超出一个块的边际改进，表明在这种情况下适度的 UHN 深度就足够了。 总体而言，结果表明默认配置block, but only marginal improvements beyond one block, suggesting that moderate UHN depth is sufficient in this setting. Overall, the results suggest that the default configuration(F𝐯,d,Nblk)=(2048,128,2)(F_{\mathbf{v}},d,N_{\mathrm{blk}})=(2048,128,2)在测试设置之间提供了强大的精度-参数权衡。 这种扩展行为支持这样一种观点，即可以通过沿标准轴增加容量来增强 UHN，而不改变整体生成机制。offers a strong accuracy–parameter trade-off among the tested settings. This scaling behavior supports the view that UHN can be strengthened by increasing capacity along standard axes without changing the overall generation mechanism.

G.3 任务结构编码器Task-Structure Encoder

G.3.1 设置Setup

UHN 可以通过以下方式以目标架构和任务的显式描述符为条件：UHN can condition on explicit descriptors of the target architecture and task via a任务结构编码器task-structure encoder。然而，目前还不清楚这种额外的调节除了基于索引的生成器之外还有多大作用。 为了隔离任务结构编码器的影响，我们禁用它，同时保持其余组件和训练协议不变，并在两种设置中进行评估： (一). However, it is unclear how much this additional conditioning contributes beyond the index-based generator. To isolate the task-structure encoder’s effect, we disable it while keeping the remaining components and training protocol unchanged, and evaluate in two settings: (i)多模型训练multi-model training两个代表性模型系列（CNN Mixed Width 和 Transformer Mixed）如下on two representative model families (CNN Mixed Width and Transformer Mixed) followingSection 4.3;和 (二); and (ii)多任务训练multi-task training跨异构任务如下across heterogeneous tasks followingSection 4.4.

G.3.2 结果Results

For multi-model training, we report test accuracy averaged over architectures in Mtrain′M^{\prime}_{\mathrm{train}}（用于保留评估的训练架构的子集；“看到”）和(the subset of training architectures used for hold-in evaluation; “seen”) andMtestM_{\mathrm{test}}（保留的测试架构；“看不见的”）。(held-out test architectures; “unseen”).Table 25报告 3 个随机种子的平均值和标准差。reports the mean and standard deviation of these averages over 3 random seeds.

对于多任务训练，我们使用 UHN 生成每个任务的基本模型并评估该任务的测试性能。For multi-task training, we use UHN to generate each task’s base model and evaluate test performance on that task.Table 26报告 3 个随机种子的平均值和标准差。 对于分类任务，我们报告reports the mean and standard deviation over 3 random seeds. For classification tasks, we report测试准确度test accuracy（越高越好）；对于公式回归，我们报告(higher is better); for formula regression, we report测试均方根误差test RMSE（越低越好）。(lower is better).

G.3.3 分析Analysis

在我们的实验中，启用任务结构编码器通常可以稳定早期训练进度。 In terms of final test performance, the effect is small and task-dependent. 在多模型训练中，启用任务结构编码器会为 CNN Mixed Width 带来轻微的增益，而对于 Transformer Mixed 则会导致轻微的性能下降。 在多任务训练中，任务结构编码器提高了某些任务（例如 CIFAR-10）的性能，对其他任务（例如图形任务）的影响可以忽略不计，并降低了公式回归的性能（RMSE 增加）。 总体而言，任务结构编码器主要改进了In our experiments, enabling the task-structure encoder often stabilizes early-stage training progress. In terms of final test performance, the effect is small and task-dependent. In multi-model training, enabling the task-structure encoder yields a slight gain for CNN Mixed Width, whereas for Transformer Mixed it leads to a slight degradation. In multi-task training, the task-structure encoder improves performance on some tasks (e.g., CIFAR-10), has a negligible effect on others (e.g., the graph tasks), and degrades performance on formula regression (RMSE increases). Overall, the task-structure encoder primarily improves优化optimization（稳定早期训练），同时对最终测试表现产生轻微且有时是混合的影响。对于多模型设置，这可能是因为一个系列中的不同模型通常高度相似，即使没有额外的结构信息也可以实现有效的硬参数共享。对于多任务设置，在我们的设置中，即使没有显式结构或任务描述符，也只有一小部分参数是硬共享的，而其余参数可以通过它们的索引来消除歧义；因此，生成器可以在训练期间隐式地学习哪些参数属于哪个任务，进一步削弱了任务结构编码器的边际效益。这些观察结果支持了我们的观点，即 UHN 的核心通用性来自于基于共享索引的生成器，其中任务结构编码器充当辅助调节模块。(stabilizing early-stage training) while having a slight and sometimes mixed effect on final test performance. For multi-model settings, this may be because different models within a family are often highly similar, enabling effective hard parameter sharing even without additional structure information. For multi-task settings, in our setup only a small subset of parameters is hard-shared even without explicit structure or task descriptors, while the remaining parameters can be disambiguated by their indices; consequently, the generator can implicitly learn which parameters belong to which task during training, further weakening the marginal benefit of the task-structure encoder. These observations support our claim that UHN’s core generality comes from the shared index-based generator, with the task-structure encoder acting as an auxiliary conditioning module.

对于递归训练，我们观察到禁用初始化会导致训练发散。For recursive training, we observe that disabling initialization causes training to diverge.

G.4.3 分析Analysis

在我们的实验中，初始化总是可以提高优化稳定性并加速早期收敛。 然而，它的影响In our experiments, initialization always improves optimization stability and accelerates early-stage convergence. However, its effect on决赛final测试性能取决于设置和任务。 在多模型训练中，初始化持续提高早期收敛性和稳定性，并且常常提高最终性能；test performance is setting- and task-dependent. In multi-model training, initialization consistently improves early-stage convergence and stability, and often improves final performance;Figure 5表明初始化大大减少了 Transformer Mixed 早期阶段的历元平均训练损失。shows that initialization substantially reduces the epoch-averaged training loss in the early phase for Transformer Mixed.

In multi-task training, initialization improves performance across all tasks, though the magnitude of the gains varies by task. In the recursive setting, initialization is essential—without it, generated downstream weights can have excessively large magnitude, leading to exploding activations and unstable gradients. 总体而言，初始化加速了跨设置的早期收敛，并且在递归情况下至关重要，并且通常会提高最终性能。In multi-task training, initialization improves performance across all tasks, though the magnitude of the gains varies by task. In the recursive setting, initialization is essential—without it, generated downstream weights can have excessively large magnitude, leading to exploding activations and unstable gradients. Overall, initialization speeds up early convergence across settings and is essential in the recursive case, and it often improves final performance.

附录HAppendix H扩展讨论Extended Discussion

本节通过提供额外的实证见解、局限性和未来方向来扩展正文讨论。This section expands the main-text discussion by providing additional empirical insights, limitations, and future directions.

跨模型和任务共享结构的证据。Evidence of shared structure across models and tasks.

我们的多模型和多任务实验表明，一种固定容量的 UHN 可以在不同的模型系列和数据集上实现具有竞争力的性能。 这表明这里考虑的模型和任务的空间在参数级别上存在大量的共享规律。 我们还观察到，删除任务结构编码器通常会保留最终性能，同时减慢优化速度，这与大部分传输通过共享参数生成器发生的解释是一致的，而任务结构编码器主要改善调节和优化动态。Our multi-model and multi-task experiments show that one fixed-capacity UHN can achieve competitive performance across diverse model families and datasets. This suggests that the space of models and tasks considered here admits substantial shared regularities at the parameter level. We also observe that removing the task-structure encoder often preserves final performance while slowing optimization, which is consistent with the interpretation that much of the transfer occurs through the shared parameter generator, whereas the task-structure encoder mainly improves conditioning and optimization dynamics.

初始化和优化稳定性。Initialization and optimization stability.

初始化对于稳定和加速训练很重要。 当初始化阶段被删除时，优化会变得更慢，并且在多模型和多任务设置中性能通常会下降。 在递归设置中，训练可能会在没有初始化的情况下发散：较高递归级别的权重尺度误差可能会通过生成链复合，导致叶模型的激活爆炸和不稳定的梯度。Initialization is important for stabilizing and accelerating training. When the initialization phase is removed, optimization becomes slower and performance typically degrades in multi-model and multi-task settings. In the recursive setting, training can diverge without initialization: errors in weight scale at higher recursion levels can compound through the generation chain, leading to exploding activations and unstable gradients at the leaf model.

H.1 局限性Limitations

与直接培训相比的潜在绩效差距。Potential performance gap versus direct training.

UHN 并不始终匹配所有任务和架构上的直接训练基线。UHN does not consistently match direct-training baselines on all tasks and architectures.

有限的正则化研究。Limited regularization study.

我们没有系统地探索超网络训练的正则化策略（例如，权重衰减）We do not systematically explore regularization strategies for hypernetwork training (e.g., weight decay(Loshchilov and Hutter, 2017)或其他先验），这可能会减少过度拟合并缩小性能差距。or other priors), which may reduce overfitting and close performance gaps.

对不可训练参数的不完整支持。Incomplete support for non-trainable parameters.

UHN does not generate non-trainable states such as BatchNorm (Ioffe and Szegedy, 2015)运行统计信息，这限制了对某些架构的适用性。running statistics, which limits applicability to some architectures.

计算开销。Compute overhead.

训练超网络到网络的映射可能会带来额外的优化成本和内存使用，并且可能需要比直接训练更长的训练计划。Training a hypernetwork-to-network mapping can introduce additional optimization cost and memory usage, and it may require longer training schedules than direct training.

H.2 未来的工作Future Work

更大的模型和更深的递归。Larger models and deeper recursion.

将 UHN 扩展到更高容量的基础模型和更深的递归模型树是实际部署的自然下一步。Extending UHN to higher-capacity base models and deeper recursive model trees is a natural next step toward practical deployment.

超网络的正则化。Regularization for hypernetworks.

正则化的系统研究（例如权重衰减）A systematic study of regularization (e.g., weight decay(Loshchilov and Hutter, 2017)，光谱约束, spectral constraints(Yoshida and Miyato, 2017)和噪声注入, and noise injection(Neelakantan et al., 2015)）可以提高泛化性和稳定性。) may improve generalization and stability.

More expressive encodings.

合并更具表现力的坐标编码（例如哈希编码Incorporating more expressive coordinate encodings (e.g., hash encodings(Müller et al., 2022)）可以提高收敛速度和样本效率。) may improve convergence speed and sample efficiency.

改进模型族泛化。Improving model-family generalization.

在小型模型集上进行训练时，提高对罕见或极端架构的鲁棒性仍然是一个重要方向。When training on small model sets, improving robustness to rare or extreme architectures remains an important direction.

生成不可训练的状态。Generating non-trainable state.

扩展生成器以产生辅助状态（例如，BatchNormExtending the generator to produce auxiliary state (e.g., BatchNorm(Ioffe and Szegedy, 2015)统计）将扩大支持的架构集。statistics) would broaden the set of architectures supported.

集成和不确定性。Ensembling and uncertainty.

Because UHN can efficiently instantiate many models, combining generated models via ensembling (Deutsch et al., 2019)并研究不确定性and studying uncertainty(Ratzlaff and Fuxin, 2019)都是有希望的方向。are promising directions.
